name: Lathe-Eternal
description: Lathe-Eternal is a gas giant of staggering proportions, its banded atmosphere spinning in counter-rotating layers that give the planet the appearance of a vast cosmic lathe turning endlessly upon itself. Cream and ochre cloud bands miles deep churn with hypersonic winds, while a permanent anticyclonic storm larger than most terrestrial worlds dominates the southern hemisphere. A thin ring of captured debris encircles the planet at a steep inclination, glittering like metal shavings scattered by a craftsman's hand.

From orbit, the planet exerts an almost hypnotic pull. The storm bands move with mesmerizing regularity, their edges razor-sharp where opposing wind currents collide at thousands of kilometers per hour. The radiation environment is punishing, bathing anything in close orbit with hard particles that degrade shielding and scramble unprotected electronics. The deep rumble of atmospheric compression can be detected on instruments even from high orbit, a subsonic heartbeat of immense power.

A derelict space station tumbles slowly through the debris ring, its hull pitted and scarred by decades of microimpacts. Registry records identify it as a fuel-harvesting platform abandoned during the Expansion Wars, its crew evacuated under circumstances that remain classified. Localized gravity anomalies near the station suggest either a malfunction in its artificial gravity systems or something more fundamental warping spacetime in its vicinity.

Lathe-Eternal's helium-3 reserves are vast enough to fuel a fleet for centuries, making it strategically invaluable despite the hazards. Salvage rights to the station are contested by three corporate entities and two sovereign governments, none of whom have successfully boarded it. The gravity anomalies are getting stronger, and the station's orbit is decaying into the cloud tops at an accelerating rate, creating an urgent timeline for anyone brave enough to investigate.
